views.description: The views whose counts the badge adds up, each a view of views.

default_sort.description: What clients call a view's own order in the sort menu, such as "View order". Required in the bundled profile; a user layer may replace it.

empty.description: What a view without its own empty shows when it lists nothing, over the view's label as `{{.label}}`. Required in the bundled profile; a user layer may replace it.

additionalProperties.description: A facet, by its id. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.

label.description: The text people read; the id when absent.

within.description: How long ago an instant may be and still fall in the bucket.

buckets.description: For a facet that sorts by time: the buckets its instants fall in, by id, in the order the file declares them; the first whose within covers the time since the instant wins, and one with no within takes the rest.

colors.description: For the facet that colors the strip: the hue of each value's strip and dot, by value; a value it does not name takes nobody's.

empty.description: What a group of tasks with no value shows.

fact.description: The fact the facet reads: a fact of a task (task.*, task.prop.*), or a field of a record kind, written <kind>.<field> (brief.risk). Required.

group.description: Whether a list can group by the facet.

label_prefix.description: Text before the label of each value the facet shows on a row, such as the `@` of a context, never in a group's head; a label that has it already keeps it, as a context configured as `@calls` does.

match.description: How a filter's text matches a value: the whole value, its last segment, its first, or a person's team.

menu.description: Whether the facet is offered in the filter menu.

merge.description: How a task's value joins its units' rows' values: union adds it to them, rows-first uses it only when no row has a value, own keeps it alone.

rank.description: The facet's values in their order, first first.

show.description: The part of a row the facet's values show in, each a button that filters by its value: a part's name, or a table of one part to the values it shows there, such as `{ flag = ["paused", "muted"] }`, or `""` to take a facet a lower layer places off the row. Absent or `""`, the facet is only for filters, groups and sorts. A value `none` and a time facet's item without a time never show.

age.description: The values the facet shows in the age part.

aside.description: The values the facet shows in the aside part.

flag.description: The values the facet shows in the flag part.

kind.description: The values the facet shows in the kind part.

meta.description: The values the facet shows in the meta part.

ref.description: The values the facet shows in the ref part.

who.description: The values the facet shows in the who part.

show_label.description: For a facet shown in the age part: the label of its date, a template over `{{.age}}`, the age in the row words, and `{{.at}}`, the time, which each client writes in its own locale, such as `since {{.at}}`. Absent, the age alone.

show_max.description: How many of an item's values the part shows at most; the rest count into one piece in the `more` row word. Absent or 0, all.

show_values.description: How many of an item's values the part shows: all, or the first alone.

additionalProperties.description: The values one facet must hold.

show_when.description: Shows the facet only on a row that holds, in each facet it names, one of the listed values, such as `{ turn = ["me"] }`; each named facet must be declared. Two age facets with opposite show_when place the row's one date by whom it waits on.

sort.description: How the facet's values order: by rank, as text, or as instants (time). Absent, as text.

strip.description: Whether each row's strip is colored by the facet's first value, its rank the strip's legend.

units.description: Which of a task's units contribute rows' values: all of them, or the primary unit alone.

values.description: The text people read for a value, by value.

facets.description: The task facets, by id: the fields every client filters, groups and sorts tasks by, in the order the file declares them, a user layer's new ones after the bundled. A plugin's row facet of the same id must agree on group, sort, rank, match and buckets.

lens.description: What every list's rows and toolbar say. Each is a template whose only actions are the `{{.name}}` its doc lists, which the clients fill in. Required in the bundled profile; a user layer may replace any.

age_days.description: A row's age from a day, over its days `{{.d}}` and the hours past them `{{.h}}`.

age_hours.description: A row's age under a day, over its hours `{{.h}}` and the minutes past them `{{.m}}`.

age_minutes.description: A row's age under an hour, over its minutes as `{{.m}}`.

age_now.description: A row's age under a minute.

board_group.description: The group menu's entry for the field a board groups by when nothing is picked, over the field's label as `{{.label}}`.

briefing.description: The flag of a row whose intake waits for its brief.

briefing_attempt.description: What the briefing flag's tooltip adds of a retried intake, over the attempt `{{.n}}`.

briefing_error.description: What the briefing flag's tooltip adds of an intake's last error, over the `{{.error}}`.

briefing_title.description: The briefing flag's tooltip, over the intake's `{{.seq}}`.

col_unit.description: What a row view whose rows mix kinds calls its unit, as `list_count`'s `{{.unit}}`.

copied.description: What Copy list says it copied, over `{{.count}}` items and the `{{.view}}` they came from.

copied_grouped.description: What Copy list says it copied from a grouped list, over `{{.count}}`, `{{.view}}` and the `{{.group}}` field's label.

countdown_minutes.description: A pending round's countdown from 100 seconds, over its minutes `{{.m}}` and the seconds past them, two digits, `{{.s}}`.

countdown_seconds.description: A pending round's countdown under 100 seconds, over the seconds `{{.s}}`.

countdown_sending.description: A pending round's countdown once its deadline passed.

countdown_title.description: The tooltip of a pending round's countdown, over the `{{.time}}` it sends at.

default_group.description: The group menu's entry for the field a view groups by on its own, over the field's label as `{{.label}}`.

descending.description: The terminal's sort entry for a field in descending order, over the field's `{{.label}}`.

due.description: The flag of a task's deadline, over the `{{.date}}`.

every.description: How often a project is reviewed, over the `{{.every}}`.

filter_group.description: What a facet button calls whom a row waits on when the value is a group of people, such as a Slack user group, in place of the facet's label.

filter_label.description: What a facet button on a row says to a screen reader, over the facet's `{{.label}}` and the `{{.value}}`.

filter_title.description: A facet button's tooltip, over the facet's `{{.label}}` and the `{{.value}}`.

filter_title_group.description: A facet button's tooltip when its facet groups, over `{{.label}}`, `{{.value}}` and the `{{.group}}` field's label.

grouped.description: What the terminal says after a group pick, over the picked entry's `{{.label}}`.

legend_title.description: The tooltip of the legend of a view's strip, the colors of its strip facet's values.

list_count.description: A row view's summary, over its `{{.unit}}`, how many rows the filter `{{.shown}}` and how many the view holds, `{{.total}}`.

list_empty.description: What a plugin view's list says when it holds no row and the plugin gives no words of its own.

more.description: The piece that counts the values a facet's `show_max` leaves off a row, over their number `{{.n}}`.

no_group.description: The group menu's entry that lists the view in one group.

no_lens.description: What the terminal says when a group or sort pick is asked where no list is on screen.

no_next_action.description: The flag of a project with no open child.

open_children.description: A project's open children, over their number `{{.n}}`.

questions.description: The pill of a brief's open questions, over their number `{{.n}}`.

review_due.description: The flag of a project past its review.

reviewed.description: When a project was last reviewed, over the `{{.date}}`.

sequential.description: The flag of a project that takes its children one at a time.

sort_by.description: The tooltip of the list toolbar's Sort chip, over the `{{.label}}` of the facet it sorts by.

sorted.description: What the terminal says after a sort pick, over the picked entry's `{{.label}}`.

stale.description: The flag of a row whose plugin is not reporting.

starred.description: The tooltip of a starred task's star.

tag_key.description: The name of the field that groups by one key of the tag facet's `key:value` values, over the tag facet's `{{.label}}` and the `{{.key}}`.

tag_key_empty.description: The group of the items with no tag of that key, over the `{{.key}}`.

tip_kind.description: A row's tooltip with its situation, over the `{{.tip}}` so far and the `{{.kind}}` labels.

tip_named.description: A row's tooltip's start when it names whom the row waits on, over the `{{.strip}}` value's label and `{{.who}}`.

tip_why.description: A row's tooltip with why it waits, over the `{{.tip}}` so far and the `{{.why}}`.

unread.description: The flag of a task whose links hold messages the extraction has not read, over how long the oldest waited, `{{.lag}}`.

until.description: The flag of a task asleep until a date, over the `{{.date}}`.

additionalProperties.description: A step of the review, by the view it walks, which views declares. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones, and comes after the steps below it.

label.description: What the step asks of you, as the review lists it. Required.

review.description: The review's steps, in the order the review walks them.

additionalProperties.description: A view, by its name. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.

empty.description: What the view shows when it lists nothing; the top-level empty when absent. A filter that matches nothing says so in its own words.

group.description: The fact the view groups by, such as task.owed_by.

hide_disabled.description: The view hides the tasks whose units are all of a disabled plugin, and the gates on a disabled plugin's units.

key.description: The key that jumps to the view: `g`, a space and a key that no core key uses, such as `g i`. Its help is the view's label, and its help line the view's summary.

label.description: The name people read in the list of views. Required.

over.description: What the view lists: tasks, or gates.

rail.description: The rail lists the view; false keeps it for the home, a queue or search.

remove_clean.description: The view offers to remove at once the workspaces its tasks' links hold whose checkouts hold nothing that is not published, as each link's remove action does; the rest are kept, with why.

sort.description: The facts the view sorts by, comma-separated; a leading - sorts one descending. A view's tasks start oldest first, a parent's children in their sibling order.

summary.description: One line on what the view lists: its tooltip in the list of views, its subtitle, and its key's help line. Required.

when.description: Which tasks or gates the view lists, over their facts: a task's, its properties' (task.prop.*), or a gate's. A view with none lists nothing: a place in the clients' list of views that a client draws itself, such as the review.

views.description: The lists of tasks, by view.
